title: Old chat resume converges when SSE precedes HTTP hydration
description: Exercise the real App, composer, live-data hook, HTTP merge and virtualizer with synthetic transport and 180 background chats. Sending must remain usable across interleaved events and hydration.
preconditions: Start the Vite dev server. The fixture mocks HTTP and EventSource and never calls a real provider.
Use localhost to isolate fixture storage from the normal 127.0.0.1 application.
Finish source edits before testing. To reset after a reload, reopen the fixture URL because App routing changes the address.

steps.target: Fill Chat input, then click Send chat message; the fixture emits SSE before resolving the POST and subsequent list refresh
Repeat send/finish for at least three rounds, including Enter submission and navigating into history while a response is running

assertions.target: Chat input and old session history
new user turn and Stop agent response button without an error boundary
Completed fixture response and enabled Send chat message button
completed latest response, readable history and enabled composer

cleanup: Close the fixture tab. No real messages were sent.
